v9-9.candidate: They tried to turn him back, saying, “We certainly cannot! Let us save our lives for now. Let us return with our brothers and fight them, but we are few.”
v9-9.close: They tried to turn him back, saying, “We certainly cannot! Let us save our lives for now. We will return with our brothers and fight them, but we are few.”

v9-39.candidate: They raised their eyes and looked, and behold, there was a commotion and much baggage. The bridegroom, his friends, and his brothers came out to meet them with tambourines, musicians, and many weapons.
v9-39.close: They raised their eyes and saw a commotion and much baggage. The bridegroom, his friends, and his brothers came out to meet them with tambourines, musicians, and many weapons.

v9-54.candidate: In the second month of the one hundred and fifty-third year, Alcimus ordered the wall of the inner court of the holy places to be demolished. He tore down the works of the prophets and began the demolition.
v9-54.close: In the second month of the one hundred and fifty-third year, Alcimus ordered the wall of the inner court of the holy places to be demolished. He began tearing down the works of the prophets.

v9-21.display:
“How has the mighty one fallen,
the saviour of Israel!”

v9-41.display:
The wedding was turned into mourning,
and the sound of their musicians into lamentation.
